section.eyebrow: Looking for something other than an assistant that answers from your documents?
section.title: Other custom solutions
section.subtitle: The plans above are for the RAG assistant. What follows are other products with their own prices: buy the software (we hand over the source code) or subscribe to the monthly SaaS (we host it for you).

modality.label: Modality
modality.compraDesc: One-time setup + optional maintenance. The source code stays with you.
modality.saasDesc: We host it, you pay monthly, cancel anytime.

banner.title: How we scale
banner.body: We work Monday to Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. (Colombia time). If your project must meet standards such as ISO 27001 or SOC 2, we define it in the scope conversation; formal certification is handled by your company. If you need more than the highest tier, we provide a custom quote within 48 business hours.
